_README: Edit SHIPPED_CELL to change what run_strategy_v4.py and run_live_v4.py use.
Every number here was measured; the 'source' fields say where. Do not change a
value without re-running the corresponding check, because the thresholds are
pre-registered and re-tuning them on the same data destroys their validity.
The one knob genuinely worth sweeping during paper trading is entry_t_minus.

entry_t_minus.meaning: Seconds before the window closes when the decision is made.
entry_t_minus.why: Earlier is better: the win rate barely changes while the price is lower.
entry_t_minus.sweep: tools_v4/checkpoint_sweep.py with the imbalance gate fixed at 0.30.

threshold.meaning: Minimum |Up-token move since the open|, in probability points.
threshold.why: Everything at or below 0.12 lost money across the sample.

min_book_imbalance.meaning: Minimum |full-depth bid-ask notional imbalance|, oriented to the side bought.
min_book_imbalance.why: THE EDGE. Pre-registered at 0.30 before the final 7 days arrived, which then returned +5.95%/day over 7/7 positive days. With the gate off the same period is flat.
min_book_imbalance.plateau: Every floor from 0.15 to 0.60 was profitable out of sample, so this is a plateau rather than a spike. Do NOT re-tune it: it is pre-registered.
min_book_imbalance.live_calibration_warning: The gate was calibrated on the dataset's full_depth_bid_notional / full_depth_ask_notional. If the live CLOB book endpoint returns a shallower top-N view, the scale differs and this threshold would need recalibrating. run_live_v4.py probe prints the live notionals so the two can be compared before trusting the gate.

min_spot_move.meaning: Minimum |BTC spot move since the window open|, as a fraction.
min_spot_move.why: Secondary gate: a token move the underlying does not support is unbacked. Survived out-of-sample testing on its own, but the imbalance gate now carries the edge.

max_entry_price.why: DISABLED ON PURPOSE. Tightening it LOWERED returns, because accuracy rises with price, so a cap discards the most accurate trades. Out-of-sample pooled: 0.88 -> -1.11%, 0.90 -> -0.54%, no cap -> -0.17% (measured before the imbalance gate existed).

take_profit_stop_loss.why: Every tight take profit won more trades and lost money (it truncates winners). Stops at 0.20 and 0.30 both reduced P&L.

fee_coefficient.why: Crypto-category taker rate, confirmed against the venue documentation. fee = C x 0.07 x p x (1-p), takers only, settlement is not a trade so no exit fee. Break-even fee for this strategy was 0.053, so the rate matters.

MEASURED_PERFORMANCE._note: 44 days / 12,670 markets. Training 22 days, out-of-sample 22 days.

with_the_gate_OFF.comment: The whole point: the same strategy without the imbalance gate is flat, because the market is fairly priced and the fee absorbs the edge.

slippage_tolerance._note: Net per share of stake at a 0.88 entry, 93.6% accuracy, fee 0.07.
slippage_tolerance.comment: The edge survives about 4 cents of extra fill cost. The pre-imbalance configuration went negative at 2 cents. This is the single biggest practical improvement.

LIVE_CHECKS._note: What to watch during paper trading, in priority order.

1_latency_drift.what: ask at decision vs ask 1s and 2s later
1_latency_drift.why: The backtest assumed a fill at the decision ask. This is the gap that decides live profitability.
1_latency_drift.where: run_live_v4.py report prints median and p90

2_imbalance_scale.what: live bid/ask notional against the dataset's full_depth_*_notional
2_imbalance_scale.why: If the live book is a shallower view, the 0.30 threshold means something different.

3_spot_freshness.why: A stale spot price can flip the 4.5bps gate, which is a small move.

4_refusal_mix.why: A sudden shift means the feed or the market changed, not that the strategy stopped working.

5_realised_frequency.why: Backtest expects ~52/day at T-180. A large shortfall means gates are firing unexpectedly.

KILL_CRITERIA._note: Decide these BEFORE the session, so the decision is not made emotionally mid-run.
abort_if: median latency drift exceeds 3 cents per share
live book notional is orders of magnitude smaller than the dataset's, so the imbalance gate cannot be trusted
realised trades per day is under a third of the expected 52
30+ settled trades accumulate and the win rate is below 90%
